review_locator: PMID:26567920, IL-15 functions as a danger signal to regulate tissue-resident T cells and tissue destruction
primary_title: The role of IL-15 in activating STAT5 and fine-tuning IL-17A production in CD4 T lymphocytes
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows exogenous IL-15 induces STAT5 activity/binding in CD4 T-cell cultures, with IL-15 receptor deficiency reducing the STAT5-associated response.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-15-to-STAT5 pathway bridge in CD4 T-cell/Th17 cultures; preserve the receptor-context and do not infer a universal STAT5 mechanism or SCI relevance.

review_locator: PMID:26567920, IL-15 functions as a danger signal to regulate tissue-resident T cells and tissue destruction
primary_title: The role of IL-15 in activating STAT5 and fine-tuning IL-17A production in CD4 T lymphocytes
decision_basis: The review-guided primary reports increased STAT5 binding at the Il17a-Il17f locus in IL-15-replete CD4 T-cell cultures and identifies STAT5 as an apparent repressor associated with reduced IL-17A production.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded STAT5-associated repression of the Il17a-Il17f locus; preserve that the primary calls STAT5 an apparent repressor and do not infer a terminal-TF status beyond the recorded STAT5 locus association.

review_locator: PMID:26567920, IL-15 functions as a danger signal to regulate tissue-resident T cells and tissue destruction
primary_title: The role of IL-15 in activating STAT5 and fine-tuning IL-17A production in CD4 T lymphocytes
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows exogenous IL-15 decreases IL-17A production in Th17 cultures, while IL-15 neutralization and Il15/Il15r deficiency increase IL-17A in culture supernatants.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a distinct protein-output edge from the IL17A gene/locus edge; preserve the CD4 T-cell/Th17 and EAE context, and do not treat IL-15 as directly binding or inhibiting IL-17A protein.
